Thursday, 8 pm. Sent it today. It took three drafts because I kept adding adjectives and then deleting them.

What I finally wrote to Pankaj, the compliance officer: the dates of the six payments, the amounts, the invoice numbers and the folder references where the papers sit. I said what I had checked and what I had not been able to check. I did not say who I thought was responsible, and I did not guess at reasons. Just facts someone else can open and verify.

Hands were cold when I pressed send. Pankaj replied within the hour, confirming receipt and saying the matter will be handled through the proper process. Now I wait, and try not to check my email every ten minutes. Wasim

subtype: Approach: file a factual written report through the proper channel [Action]

The sugar cooperative's office in Kagal was a long room of steel cupboards and slow ceiling fans. In his fourth month there, Akash, the junior accountant, found that the transport contractor had been paid for 212 truckloads of cane in December, while the weighbridge register recorded 164.
He didn't mention it at tea. He didn't write 'cheating' anywhere. He spent two evenings putting together one page: the month, the two numbers, the payment voucher numbers, the weighbridge register page numbers, and one line at the end: 'Requesting review of the difference of 48 loads.'
On Monday he put it in a sealed envelope marked 'Confidential' and handed it to Ujjwal, the cooperative's compliance officer, in person.
Ujjwal read it at his desk while Akash waited. 'This is clear. I'll check the register and the vouchers myself this week. Don't discuss it with anyone in accounts. If anyone treats you differently, come to me directly.'
Akash walked back to his desk with his heart still racing, but lighter.

qa.q: How many truckloads did the weighbridge register record?
How did Akash feel walking back to his desk?
qa.a: His heart was still racing, but he felt lighter and relieved after handing it over.

qa.q: Why did Akash avoid the word 'cheating' in the report?
qa.a: A factual page lets the compliance officer check the numbers independently, without it becoming an accusation.

qa.q: How does the report look to Ujjwal?
qa.a: Ujjwal finds it clear and easy to check, and promises to review it personally while protecting Akash.

grounding: Shows a junior accountant handing the compliance officer a one-page factual report with numbers and document references, avoiding accusation.
